description: This file is a PHP source file for a web application module related to test plan and test case management within the TestLink project. It handles updating test cases linked to test plans, including bulk updates to their latest versions, and provides various processing functions for test plan, test suite, and test case details. The file also manages user interface interactions and access rights.

classes.name: stdClass
classes.description: Standard generic class used for dynamic object property assignment.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes request arguments from the GET/POST request and session data for test plan management.

methods.name: doUpdate
methods.description: Performs batch updating of selected test case versions within a test plan based on user input.

methods.name: initializeGui
methods.description: Sets up GUI data structure with default values for test case update operations.

methods.name: processTestSuite
methods.description: Filters and processes test suite data for display within a test plan context.

methods.name: doUpdateAllToLatest
methods.description: Updates all test case versions linked to a test plan to their latest versions.

methods.name: processTestCase
methods.description: Prepares detailed view data for a specific test case within a test plan.

methods.name: processTestPlan
methods.description: Gathers information about linked test cases and their latest versions for display and potential bulk updates.

methods.name: tideUpForGUI
methods.description: Adjusts data structures to facilitate user interface display and operation consistency.

methods.name: checkRights
methods.description: Verifies user permissions for accessing test plan operations.
